gen-gf-bruno-ace-gf-tirra: Bruno Ace draws every letter with a ruler-straight, constant-width line, and its counters stay open to the outside. Tirra keeps text moving smoothly with round forms like open parentheses.
gen-gf-bruno-ace-gf-tsukimi-rounded: Expressive from the first glyph, Bruno Ace keeps its counters connected outward. Bruno Ace is best at lingering, ruler-straight display lettering, while Tsukimi Rounded does its best work in parallel-edged curves that read cleanly.
gen-gf-bruno-ace-gf-urbanist: Bruno Ace holds a single ruler-drawn line and keeps every counter linked to the outside, with a lingering one-letter-per-beat rhythm. Urbanist supports it with a sans stroke that never curls shut.
gen-gf-bruno-ace-gf-varta: Neon-tube strokes in Bruno Ace never change weight, however far a word runs. Varta takes over below as plain sans, its big open eyes giving the text room to breathe.
gen-gf-bruno-ace-gf-ysabeau-office: Ysabeau Office keeps every curve open-ended, a quiet sans beneath Bruno Ace. Paragraphs slide by easily, since the curves never close up, while the heading lingers above on ruler-drawn lines.
gen-gf-bruno-ace-gf-ysabeau-sc: Bruno Ace draws a pipe-cleaner line of constant width, its counters open to the outside and each character given its own beat. Ysabeau SC, with a visibly gaping c, lets text unspool without crowding.
gen-gf-bruno-ace-gf-zalando-sans: Friendly and unfussy, Zalando Sans leaves every curve open-ended and approachable. Beneath the wire-like line of Bruno Ace, that plain sans lets paragraphs unroll steadily without snagging the eye.
gen-gf-bruno-ace-gf-zalando-sans-expande: Bruno Ace has a single-weight outline feel, with counters open to the outside and a lingering beat per character. Zalando Sans Expanded spaces plain sans letters wide apart, so text unfolds slowly and cleanly.
gen-gf-bruno-ace-gf-zcool-xiaowei: Modern in feel, ZCOOL XiaoWei varies its stroke weight gently from stem to serif. Bruno Ace excels at one uniform stroke from end to end, whereas ZCOOL XiaoWei excels at gentle modulation.
